summary.text: Cristina Parajón is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 25 who was appointed to the seat in 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Parajón graduated from Nicaraguan Christian Academy International in 2014, earned a bachelor's degree in sociology and government from Harvard University in 2018, and earned a master's degree in management sciences from Schwarzman College in 2019.

Parajón's career experience includes working as director of strategy of the New Mexico Department of Human Services, as a gateway administrator with the City of Albuquerque, and as a consultant with Oliver Wyman.
The Bernalillo County Commission appointed Parajón to House District 25 on August 17, 2023, to replace Christine Trujillo (D).
